customManagers.description: Cua Spaces has no apt repository: its release is pinned in the host play.

packageRules.description: A Postgres major needs a dump and restore, not an Image= bump.
A Cua Spaces release is taken only once it is 3 days old, as the old daily update did.

Safe updates merge themselves (fleet-ops#11920, owner 2026-11-12): a minor, patch or digest bump with green CI merges with no owner click; a major keeps the owner hold. The schedule is the Sunday maintenance window, 03:00-05:00 IST (unattended-upgrades 03:00, reboot 03:30, docs/daily-update.md): a merged image bump restarts its container on deploy, so it lands there. The schedule scopes PR creation to the window, and the platform auto-merge enqueues at PR creation, so the merge lands in the window too; merge-queue support goes through platform automerge, so it stays on (docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/#schedule; docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/automerge).
